summary: The sheet contains door and hardware schedules, window types, hardware notes, and related product/detail information. One title-block drafting issue was observed: the first-issue revision entry contains an incomplete date value.

drafts.title: Incomplete first-issue revision date
drafts.observation: The revision table lists “00 FIRST ISSUE 00,” leaving the date field as “00” rather than a complete date.
drafts.drawing_evidence: Revision table at the right side of the title block shows “00 FIRST ISSUE 00.” Other revision entries show dates such as “10/29/25,” “12/16/25,” and “10/15/26.”
drafts.recommendation: Confirm whether the first-issue date is intentionally represented by “00.” If not, replace the placeholder with the actual issue date and coordinate the revision history with the permit-set issue information.
